name: Fractal Brownian Motion (fBm) with Perlin Noise
definition: A technique to generate rougher, more natural-looking noise by summing multiple octaves of base noise with increasing frequency and decreasing amplitude.
summary: Fractal Brownian Motion with Perlin Noise generates natural-looking textures by summing multiple octaves of gradient noise, creating self-similar detail that distinguishes it from standard Perlin noise.
